premises: Yttrium addition (0.5–1 at.%) to CoCrFeMnNi can be achieved via conventional casting and homogenization without detrimental effects.
Yttrium will segregate to the surface under operational stress and temperature.
Segregated yttrium will oxidize to form a continuous, nanostructured Y2O3-rich tribolayer in situ.
A Y2O3 tribolayer acts as a low-shear interface and protective barrier, reducing friction and wear.
The predicted 25–40% reduction in friction and wear is achievable across room temperature to 800 °C in oxidizing conditions.
